title: Macro Deck Countdown widget data (v1)
description: Describes the JSON stored in WidgetEntity.Data for a Countdown widget (WidgetType.Countdown).
$comment: No top-level 'required': a freshly created widget's data is a near-empty JSON object, and every property here has to stay optional so it keeps validating. additionalProperties is deliberately left unset (defaults to true) on this schema and on every nested object - an older or newer client, or a plugin-driven flow, may write extension keys this schema does not know about, and rejecting them would make the widget unsavable.

mode.description: 'fixed' counts down from durationHours, durationMinutes and durationSeconds; 'ask' asks for the duration in a dialog each time the countdown is started from Idle. Absent or null means 'fixed'.

durationHours.description: Hours of the fixed duration used in 'fixed' mode. The three duration parts add up; when none is present the duration is five minutes, and a total below one second counts as one second.

durationMinutes.description: Minutes of the fixed duration used in 'fixed' mode.

durationSeconds.description: Seconds of the fixed duration used in 'fixed' mode.

label.description: Caption shown under the time. Empty or null shows no caption.

accentColor.description: Color of the ring while the timer runs. Absent or null uses the deck's accent color.

backgroundColor.description: Widget background color. Absent or null uses the deck's own tile color.

border.description: Outline drawn along the widget edge.

flows.description: Action flows for the countdown's own triggers (onCountdownStarted, onCountdownPaused, onCountdownReset, onCountdownFinished, onCountdownDismissed) and event triggers, stored the same way as an Action Button's. Stored on the wire as a nested JSON string; the editor may show it inlined as an array. Both forms are accepted here.

widgetBorder.description: Outline drawn along the inner edge of the widget.

style.description: Visual style; absent, null or 'off' means no border. The color-tinted styles are static, heartbeat, breathing, blink, comet and ants; hue-shift and rgb ignore color.

color.description: Ring color for the color-tinted styles. Falls back to a default color when absent or null; ignored by hue-shift and rgb.

actionFlow.description: One action-flow entry (a trigger and its action blocks). Its internal structure is deliberately not validated here - deep flow validation is out of scope for this schema.
